title: Assurance B: the TLA+ models and the code agree
note: Each mutation makes the implementation drift from a TLA+ model in docs/formal. The suite is tests/test_formal_conformance.py ALONE: a kill shows the conformance tests -- edge comparison, trace replay, counterexample replay, plan comparison -- notice the drift on their own. A model check proves the model; this is what ties it to the code.

mutations.name: FC1_a_proposer_may_verify_its_own_claim
mutations.find:
requires_evidence=frozenset({"verification_report"}),
          requires_distinct_actor=True,
          reason="verification passed (I4: not the proposer)"),
mutations.replace:
requires_evidence=frozenset({"verification_report"}),
          requires_distinct_actor=False,
          reason="verification passed (I4: not the proposer)"),
mutations.rationale: the gate would describe another machine than AuthorityPromotion.tla's, and the self_verify counterexample would run through the store

mutations.name: FC2_a_withdrawn_policy_still_promotes
mutations.find:
if refusal is not None:
                    raise StoreError(f"{record_id} -> PROMOTED: {refusal}")
mutations.rationale: the withdrawn_policy counterexample would promote through the store's write path

mutations.name: FC3_an_attempt_dispatched_twice
mutations.find: if att.dispatch_seq is not None or att.result is not None:
mutations.rationale: the double_dispatch counterexample would run through the gateway, and replay would accept it

mutations.name: FC4_the_budget_checks_only_what_is_held
mutations.rationale: the check_held_only counterexample would overspend through the gateway

mutations.name: FC5_a_failed_dispatch_costs_nothing
mutations.rationale: the gateway's ledger would disagree with the model's settlement rule on a replayed behaviour

mutations.name: FC6_a_superseded_context_still_decides
mutations.rationale: the check_at_build and check_then_act counterexamples would be granted

mutations.name: FC7_invalidation_reaches_one_level
mutations.rationale: the planner would make the direct_only plan, and a record two links from the origin would stay standing

mutations.name: FC8_invalidation_stops_at_a_record_that_cannot_go_stale
mutations.rationale: the planner would make the stop_at_skipped plan, and the dependents of a SUPERSEDED record would stay standing

mutations.name: FC9_an_edited_specification_keeps_its_old_result
mutations.rationale: a specification changed after it was checked would still be reported as checked

mutations.name: FC10_a_variant_that_was_not_refuted_passes
mutations.find: if got != expected or r["expected"] != expected:
mutations.rationale: a broken variant TLC did not refute -- a property shown unable to fail -- would go unreported
